title: Jelly's routine, his claimed age and vanity
summary: He had calls to check, made her say he was 28, pulled gray hair and had capped teeth.

story.theme_name: Chicago: the jazz migration and its clubs
story.community_name: Going north: working the Chicago jazz scene

blocks.x: Didn't cook themselves to death, but they didn't have any liquor. Did he practice much when you would be there? Of course, he was sick that when you were in our house.
I mean, and you see, I wasn't around him in the daytime.
He'd have to come and get me.

He wouldn't let me come to Chicago by myself. He'd always come and get me. We'd go out to the place. We'd stop at his place for a little while to see if he had any calls. Because I don't know whether he was working regularly or not. But anyway, he'd say he was going to see if he had any calls. Yes. And I didn't know what they were. I didn't ask any questions. But he truly had me to remember that he was 28. And no matter how old I was, not to tell it.
So you were only 25 then. That's right.
I wasn't quite 25 when I was there. I was 24. So you would have been younger.
He would have been about almost 40 years old. Thirty-39, like Jack Benny.
He would take his tweezers and pull his gray hair out. Oh, he did? Oh, yeah. He wanted to be young. He was younger than me. Well, musicians in the public eye, they like to...

That's right. And he was so particular about his teeth, he had two or three of them, caps. Now that I know what it means, we said white caps on them, you know what I mean? So that it would show up your diamond all the time. And you could just look in his mouth and see that thing. If life was facing him anyway. Is that an upper tooth that had the diamond? An upper tooth right next to his eye teeth. Right there. Down the left side. He had four teeth in there and he had one of them right on the left side. They say he was flamboyant. But I mean to say this, whatever that means, he wasn't around us that way. No. My sister was so... When I came back and was telling her about him, and he didn't want me to tell him that she was sick. She was sick and he didn't want me to tell her that he was sick. So when I came back I just, I didn't even write until he was sick. And she wanted to know why I didn't stay with him. Didn't he have a wife? And so I said, no he found a place for me where I could be, they had two or three girls younger than me and one older than me. And he wanted me where they had young people. Yeah. Like myself. And when I found...
